name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2025-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.12 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
